evidence_sentence: The function converts the ASN1_OBJECT to a string using OBJ_obj2txt and then prints the resulting string to the specified BIO stream using BIO_printf.
rationale: The Logic explicitly states that output is performed with BIO_printf. That call appears only in the fixed implementation; the vulnerable implementation instead uses the length returned by OBJ_obj2txt in BIO_write followed by a separate newline write. Thus the docstring identifies the fixed-side output mechanism and exposes the patch-relevant behavioral choice.
rewritten_docstring: The function converts the ASN1_OBJECT to a string using OBJ_obj2txt and then writes the resulting string followed by a newline to the specified BIO stream.
